description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_HandoverToLogistics" name="Order handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DeliveryStatus" name="Delivery status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Order">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_CustomerOrdering"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Fulfillment" name="Order Fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics Provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted" sourceRef="Send_OrderSubmitted" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation" sourceRef="Send_OrderConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Handover" name="Order handover" messageRef="Msg_HandoverToLogistics" sourceRef="Send_HandoverToLogistics" targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information" messageRef="Msg_TrackingInformation" sourceRef="Send_TrackingInformation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryStatus" name="Delivery status update" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryStatus" sourceRef="Participant_Logistics" targetRef="Monitor_Shipment"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CustomerOrdering" name="Customer Ordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderNeeded" name="Customer wants to order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" name="Ordering channel"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrderOnline" name="Place order via online platform"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PlaceOrderByPhone" name="Place order by phone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" name="Order placed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_OrderSubmitted" name="Submit order to order fulfillment" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_01" sourceRef="Start_OrderNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_02" name="Online" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrderOnline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_03" name="Phone" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrderByPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_04" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderOnline" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_05" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderByPhone" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" targetRef="Send_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_07" sourceRef="Send_OrderSubmitted" targetRef="End_OrderSubmitted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order Fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Fulfillment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OrderManagement" name="Order Management">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Send_OrderConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Send_TrackingInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Monitor_Shipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ProcessEnded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_FeedbackOrReturn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_WarehouseTeam" name="Warehouse Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickAndPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateShippingLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Send_HandoverToLogistics</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderReceived" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_OrderConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PickAndPack" name="Pick and pack items"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_HandoverToLogistics" name="Hand over order to logistics provider" messageRef="Msg_HandoverToLogistics"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_TrackingInformation" name="Send tracking information to customer" messageRef="Msg_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Monitor_Shipment" name="Monitor shipment until delivered to customer address" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryStatus"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delivered" name="Delivered to customer?" default="Flow_NotDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordDelivery" name="Record successful delivery"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProcessEnded" name="Order fulfillment process ended"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Handle customer feedback or return" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FeedbackOrReturn" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn" name="Handle feedback or return"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackHandled" name="Feedback or return handled"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FB_01" sourceRef="Start_FeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FB_02" sourceRef="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="End_FeedbackHandled"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Send_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Send_OrderConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_PickAndPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Send_HandoverToLogistics"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Send_HandoverToLogistics" targetRef="Send_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Send_TrackingInformation" targetRef="Monitor_Shipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Monitor_Shipment" targetRef="Gateway_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="Task_RecordDelivery">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${delivered == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotDelivered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="Monitor_Shipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_RecordDelivery" targetRef="End_ProcessEnded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
